campaign-5-napalos.desc: Convert an abandoned theatre into an aquarium!
napalos_intro.title: Welcome to Napalos
napalos_intro.text.0:
This theatre has fallen into disuse. You are going to convert it into a successful aquarium!

This is your opportunity to demonstrate everything you have learned so far, it's time to build an aquarium of your own design!

The only conditions of success are that you must reach Rank 7 and obtain a minimum number of different animal species.

You will have opportunities to complete optional Objectives as you grow. It is up to you whether you accept these, but you may find it easier to succeed if you do. Good luck!
opt_napalos_green_pellet.title: Herbivore Habitat
opt_napalos_green_pellet.text.0: Would you be interested in creating a sponsored exhibit? I'd love to see a display showing herbivores in a natural looking habitat.
opt_napalos_green_pellet_complete.title: Happy Herbivores!
opt_napalos_green_pellet_complete.text.0: The display is looking great, here's the rest of the sponsorship money.
napalos_staff_talks.title: Staff talks
napalos_staff_talks.text.0: Now you are Rank 7 you have access to the Podium and Mic Headset. These allow you to schedule staff talks!
napalos_staff_talks.text.3:
Staff talks allow you to generate additional points <sprite name="ecology">,<sprite name="science">,<sprite name="prestige">. The type of point you get depends on the talk.

Your choice of talk depends on what animals are in the nearby tanks so place your Podium carefully. The number of points earned depends on the Talking skill of the staff member and the number of guests that are nearby.

Complete the new optional Objective by putting on your first talk!
napalos_epaulette_shark.title: Epaulette Shark
napalos_epaulette_shark.text.0: You've just unlocked the Epaulette Shark.
napalos_epaulette_shark.text.2: Along with all other Sharks, the Epaulette needs a supplement to stay healthy.
napalos_epaulette_shark.text.4: This supplement needs to be fed in addition to normal food, every few days. Ensure you have a Supplement Cabinet in your aquarium.
napalos_epaulette_shark.text.6: Finally, feeding supplements is skilful work and will take a lot longer for staff with low Feeding skill.
staffManagementC.title: Staff zoning
staffManagementC.text.0:
Did you know you can assign specific zones for your staff to work in?

Staff will only carry out tasks which are inside their zone. This gives you more control over which staff work where and allows you to manage your staff more efficiently.
staffManagementC.text.2: Complete the new optional Objective you've just been given to learn how to create zones for your staff!
openStaffManageTab.tooltip: First open the Staff window and then select the Manage tab.
selectZoneButton: Click Zone Button for any staff
selectZoneButton.tooltip: The Zone Button is in the middle of the row, it will say 'No zone assigned' if the staff hasn't been assigned to a zone yet.
createNewZone.tooltip:
While in the zoning tool, click the 'Create new zone' button.

To get to the zoning tool, open the Staff Manage tab and click on the Zone Button for any staff.
addToZone: Drag to add to the zone area
addToZone.tooltip: While in the zoning tool with a zone selected, left click and drag anywhere on the screen to add to the zone.
subtractFromZone.tooltip: While in the zoning tool with a zone selected, left click and drag within the existing area to subtract from the zone.
renameZone.tooltip: In the zoning tool, the rename button is to the far right of the zone's name. The icon is a pencil writing on paper. Once you've clicked it, you will be able to type to edit the zone's name directly. Hit enter or click anywhere when you've finished writing the zone's name.
assignStaffToZone.tooltip: While in the zoning tool, click the 'Assign staff' button to the right of the zone's name to actually assign the staff to that zone.
deleteZone.tooltip: While in the zoning tool, the delete button is to the far right of the zone's name. The icon is a little cross. When a zone is deleted, all staff members assigned to that zone will revert to having no zone assigned.
opt_zoning_complete.title: Master of Zoning
opt_zoning_complete.text.0:
Nicely done! You now know how to create, edit and assign staff to zones.

Zones have many uses, for example: they can be used to keep staff working in a specific area so they spend less time walking between jobs; you can use them to divide your staff between jobs evenly to make sure everything gets done; you can even use them to force certain staff to do certain jobs, for example, getting a skilled staff member to work on difficult tasks to make the best use of their time.

Now it's up to you to experiment and work out how to get the best out of your team!
staffWithTalking.tooltip: Hire a staff with the Talking skill via the Staff menu in the bottom right.
talkTypeEpauletteShark: Schedule talk about the Epaulette Shark
talkTypeEpauletteShark.tooltip:
Make sure you place your podium near your tank with the Epaulette Shark.

Select your Podium. Use the dropdown in its window to change the talk type to Epaulette Shark.

If if doesn't have that talk available, check that it is close enough to a tank with an Epaulette Shark in it.
napalos_win_message.title: You win!
napalos_win_message.text.0:
You've done it! You have proven that you have the creative vision and management experience needed to create an aquarium from scratch and build it into an aquatic paradise.

If you're looking for a new challenge I have identified an aquatic research facility in Hartcliff that could be a golden opportunity.
napalos_win_message.text.2:
You can continue to build here at Napalos for as long as you want, this message will stay in your message log (accessible via the button in the bottom-left) until you're ready.

When you're ready to move on to Hartcliff, let me know.
napalos_win_message.reply.0: I'm ready to check out the research facility in Hartcliff.
napalos_nitrate.title: Nitrate Reactor
napalos_nitrate.text.0: You've just unlocked the Nitrate Reactor.
napalos_nitrate.text.2:
Nitrate Reacting is a 3rd way to increase water quality. Combine filtering, protein skimming and nitrate reacting in equal amounts to achieve the highest water quality.

But be warned, Nitrate Reactors are much more expensive than Filters and Protein Skimmers, you should only use them when you need a very high water quality.
